implementation.primitive: After existing DC/TM prediction, compare the complete 8x8 or16x16 source plane with its prediction. On equality add size*size to bin0 and skip transforms/histogram calls. Check cancellation each compared row. Disable the shortcut when histogram capacity is incomplete or populations alias either borrowed pixel span. Eighteen added production lines; no changed DCT kernel or source policy.
implementation.proof: Zero residuals do not produce an entirely zero forward transform: current integer rounding leaves coefficient1=1 and the other15 zero. Every magnitude is below8, so each block contributes exactly16 samples to bin0. A complete exact matching plane therefore adds size*size to that bin, preserving DC/TM source summaries and later segmentation/modes/packets. Predicate is exact equality, not a tolerance. Aliases retain the original sequential feedback path.
implementation.ownership: Same admitted scratch and borrowed source/prediction/population spans, capacities and lifetimes. No heap allocation, retained cache/owner or new budget abstraction. Direct row cancellation checkpoints remain cooperative; refusal stays terminal.

attributionLead.interpretation: Retained effort2 attribution predates histogram aggregation; its shares are not current phase costs. Actual CollectPlane callers still transform and histogram every block of an exact matching plane. The shortcut removes that complete work, without another kernel/threshold variant.
